faq.q1: How do I create my Flux account?
faq.a1: Click "Sign up" in the top right, then enter your email and a secure password. Confirm your email via the activation link sent to your inbox. Your account is ready!
faq.q2: How do I book a hotel or a place to stay?
faq.a2: Use the search bar to enter your destination and dates. Browse the results, pick your preferred accommodation, and click "Book". Follow the payment steps to confirm your booking.
faq.q3: How do I modify or cancel my booking?
faq.a3: Log in to your account, go to "My bookings" and select the relevant booking. Modification or cancellation options depend on the property's policy. Check the terms before proceeding.
faq.q4: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a4: Flux accepts credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) and digital wallets. All payments are secure and encrypted.
faq.q5: How do I contact the owner or the hotel?
faq.a5: Once your booking is confirmed, you can contact the owner directly through Flux messaging. For questions before booking, use the contact form on the listing.
faq.q6: How do I add my listing on Flux?
faq.a6: Create a professional account, go to your dashboard and click "New listing". Fill in your accommodation's details (description, price, availability, photos) and publish it.
faq.q7: Are there fees to list my property?
faq.a7: Creating a listing is free. Flux takes a commission on each confirmed booking. Check our rates in your professional dashboard.
faq.q8: How do I manage bookings and availability?
faq.a8: Your dashboard shows all bookings. You can update rates and availability in real time via the interactive management calendar.
faq.q9: How do I receive payments for bookings?
faq.a9: Set up your bank details in the payment settings. Funds are paid out automatically after each booking (timing depends on your bank).
faq.q10: How do I increase my listing's visibility?
faq.a10: Optimize your listing with quality photos, a detailed description, and competitive rates. Reply quickly to requests and encourage positive reviews to improve your ranking.
faq.q11: My account has been blocked. What should I do?
faq.a11: Check the email we sent you to find out why. Contact our support team for more details and possible solutions.
faq.q12: Is my data secure on Flux?
faq.a12: Yes, we use SSL encryption, two-factor authentication protection, and comply with GDPR standards to protect your personal data.
faq.q13: How do I change my password?
faq.a13: Log in to your account, go to "Settings" → "Security" and click "Change password". Follow the instructions sent by email to confirm.
faq.q14: I can't log in. What should I do?
faq.a14: Click "Forgot password?" to reset your password. If the problem persists, contact our support via the contact form.
faq.trouvez_reponses: Find answers to the most common questions about using Flux.
faq.pas_trouve_reponse: If you can't find the answer to your question, our experts are here to help.

conditions.s1_corps: Flux is a matchmaking platform that lets you browse hotel and housing listings and contact the relevant professionals or owners. Flux facilitates search and booking but is not a party to the contract between the user and the provider.
conditions.s2_corps: Access to Flux's features may require creating an account. The user agrees to provide accurate information, keep their credentials confidential, and promptly report any unauthorized use of their account.
conditions.s3_corps: Listings are published under the responsibility of hoteliers and landlords. The user must verify the listing's information before making any booking or request. The terms, availability, prices, and cancellation conditions in effect are those communicated at the time of booking.
conditions.s4_corps: When payment is offered on Flux, it is made through the means indicated on the platform. The user agrees to use a payment method they are authorized to use. Any payment anomaly must be reported to support as soon as possible.
conditions.s5_corps: It is forbidden to use Flux to publish false information, circumvent payment, infringe on others' rights, distribute unlawful content, or disrupt the service. Flux may suspend or delete an account in the event of a breach.
conditions.s6_corps: Flux uses reasonable means to ensure the availability and reliability of the service. However, Flux does not guarantee uninterrupted service and cannot be held liable for information published by providers, their services, or events beyond its control.
conditions.s7_corps: The data collected is used to provide and secure the service, manage accounts, and process requests. It is processed in accordance with applicable regulations. The user may contact Flux with any questions regarding their data.
conditions.s8_corps: For any questions about these terms, contact us at noutta.cm@gmail.com. Flux may update these terms; the version published on this page is the applicable version.

politique.s1_corps: Flux places great importance on protecting your personal data. This policy explains what information is collected when you use the platform, why it is used, and what your rights are.
politique.s2_corps: When creating an account or using our services, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, gender, account role, and information needed to process your bookings, housing requests, and payments.
politique.s3_corps: Your data allows us to create and secure your account, process your bookings and requests, facilitate communication with hoteliers and landlords, manage payments, send you useful notifications, and improve how Flux works.
politique.s4_corps: We do not sell your personal data. Certain strictly necessary information may be shared with the provider involved in a booking or request, as well as with the technical and payment services essential to carrying out the service.
politique.s5_corps: We retain your data for as long as necessary to manage your account, carry out our services, and comply with our legal obligations. Reasonable technical and organizational measures are implemented to protect your information against unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.
politique.s6_corps: Flux may use cookies or similar technologies necessary for session operation, security, and remembering certain preferences. Technical data may also be collected to ensure the platform's stability and security.
politique.s7_corps: Depending on applicable regulations, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data, as well as the restriction of or objection to certain processing. To exercise your rights, write to us at noutta.cm@gmail.com.
politique.s8_corps: This policy may be updated to reflect changes to Flux, its services, or applicable regulations. The version published on this page indicates the date of its last update.

client.reserver_hotel_li1: The total cost updates live on the booking form as soon as you choose your dates.
client.reserver_hotel_li2: After confirming, you're redirected to payment (MTN MoMo or Orange Money): a message is sent to your phone for you to approve.
client.reserver_hotel_li3: Your booking becomes "confirmed" as soon as the payment is validated.
client.reserver_hotel_li4: Once your stay is over, a pro-forma is emailed to you and stays downloadable from "My bookings".
client.louer_logement_li1: From a property listing, enter your desired duration (at least the required minimum) and contact the landlord.
client.louer_logement_li2: Once the landlord agrees, you must pay an initial payment covering the deposit and the minimum-duration months.
client.louer_logement_li3: Following months can be paid at your own pace (end of month, every two months...) from "My rentals".
client.louer_logement_li4: You can request an extension of your lease; it must be approved by the landlord.
client.louer_logement_li5: At the end of the lease (grace period included), a summary pro-forma is emailed to you.
client.favoris_avis_desc: Add hotels to your favorites to find them easily. Your reviews and ratings on a hotel or property are publicly visible after moderation (for hotels) or immediately (for properties).

hotelier.creer_hotel_li1: Enter the name, city, number of stars, and a cover image.
hotelier.creer_hotel_li2: Your hotel is not immediately visible: it goes into pending approval by an admin. You receive an email as soon as it's approved or rejected.
hotelier.creer_hotel_li3: Any later change also puts the hotel back into approval.
hotelier.creer_hotel_li4: Then add the photo gallery, social links, and your payment contacts (MTN MoMo / Orange Money) from the hotel page.
hotelier.categories_chambres_desc: Each hotel can have several room categories (name, capacity, nightly price, amenities). This is what clients book from your hotel's page.
hotelier.reservations_li1: A client booking shows as "pending" until its payment is confirmed.
hotelier.reservations_li2: You can manually confirm or cancel a booking if needed.
hotelier.reservations_li3: On the departure date, the stay is closed automatically: you receive an email, and the client receives their pro-forma.
hotelier.avis_desc: Displayed reviews have been approved by an admin. You can view them but not edit them.

bailleur.ajouter_logement_li1: As with hotels, a property is only visible on the site after approval by an admin (upon creation and after each edit).
bailleur.ajouter_logement_li2: Villas are automatically furnished — the category field locks to "furnished".
bailleur.ajouter_logement_li3: You can group several identical properties into a mini-estate and generate several copies at once.
bailleur.ajouter_logement_li4: The grace period (7 days by default, adjustable per property) is the delay after a lease ends before the property becomes visible again — time to vacate it or for an extension to be requested.
bailleur.demandes_baye_li1: When a client contacts you, a request appears with the desired duration (at least your property's minimum duration).
bailleur.demandes_baye_li2: By approving, a lease is created and an initial payment (deposit + minimum duration) is requested from the client; the property becomes "rented".
bailleur.demandes_baye_li3: The following months are paid by the client at their own pace — you track payment status in "Active rentals".
bailleur.prolongations_li1: Any extension request from a client must be approved by you before it applies.
bailleur.prolongations_li2: Once the lease ends (grace period elapsed), the property automatically becomes visible on the site again — you receive a confirmation email with the lease's summary pro-forma.
bailleur.recevoir_loyers_desc: Add your MTN MoMo / Orange Money numbers in your profile: that's where your tenants' payments are sent.

admin.validations_li1: Accounts to approve: every hotelier/landlord application must be reviewed before the person can log in. You receive an email for each new request.
admin.validations_li2: Hotels to approve: a hotel created by a hotelier is only visible on the site after your approval.
admin.validations_li3: Properties to approve: same principle for properties added by landlords — including after an edit.
admin.validations_li4: If rejecting, always provide a reason: it is emailed to the person concerned.
admin.moderation_desc: Client reviews on hotels only appear publicly after your approval in "Review moderation". The hotel's average rating is recalculated automatically with each approval.
admin.consultation_desc: "All hotels", "All properties", "All leases", and "All bookings" give you a complete view of platform activity. You can view everything but not edit anything directly — management stays with the relevant hotelier, landlord, or client.
admin.rapports_desc: Total revenue and the breakdown by hotel and city are calculated from confirmed payments (MTN MoMo / Orange Money). Pending or failed payments are not included.
admin.automatisations_desc: Two scheduled tasks run every day: closing out stays (sending the pro-forma) and processing expired leases (freeing up the property once the grace period has elapsed). They must be run via php artisan schedule:work or a cron job.
